info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Authentication Management API
info.description: The Party Authentication Management API enables secure and efficient updates to user authentication statuses across various banking channels. This API allows authorized consumers to modify authentication settings for specific parties. Use cases typically involve financial institutions or service providers seeking to manage customer access rights or enhance security measures. This ensures a robust authentication framework, enhancing both user experience and security.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update an existing party's authentication details within the cross-channel framework. Ensure to provide all required fields for a successful update.

requestBody.description: Request body to update the details of the party authentication for the specified party ID. This request should include the necessary fields that need to be modified in the existing party authentication record.
